subject: Re: Kickoff: flow subspaces for motion-aware video editing
body:
Lucia,

Staffing and the plan for the interactive-speed constraint.

Reproduction: Csilla 50% on the scene-prediction network and the loss stack, Vera 30% on data and evals. On track for May 22.

The 'mobile-feasible variant' is the bigger lift. The full network is nowhere near interactive on device, so the path is teacher-student distillation. We are scoping and staffing a distillation training recipe built from scratch: Yara Jokic leads at 50% with Wei Ivanov at 40% to design the student architecture, loss schedule, and training pipeline. Target: a student under 40ms per frame on the reference mobile SoC that keeps at least 90% of the teacher's flow-projection quality.

Compute: 32 A100s on Titan best-effort for reproduction, and I will come back with a separate ask for distillation once Yara sizes the student sweeps.

Alina
